comments: bootstrap 3 uses `@media all and (transform-3d),(-webkit-transform-3d)` for , but `(transform-3d)`
no confirmation found that unprefixed min/max-device-pixel-ratio is supported by any browser

comments: horizontal, vertical, decrement, increment, start, end, double-button, single-button, no-button, corner-present and window-inactive are all about scrollbar states

comments: -ms- for gradients – preview releases of IE10 used a "-ms" prefixed syntax, and IE10 onwards use the standard syntax (https://stackoverflow.com/questions/15957320/css3-linear-gradient-on-ie10)
constant() was used for Safari TP and then renamed into standarded env() in release
